name: Kenco MCS Jeffersonville II - Jeffersonville IN

fieldNotes.site: Kenco has two logistics buildings on the Jeffersonville side of River Ridge Commerce Center. idx 1 (Jeffersonville I) is documented at 201 River Ridge Parkway, 664,800 SF, AutoStore robotics - it is the central NE-SW building at the idx 1 roster geocode. idx 10 (Jeffersonville II, 468,635 SF, food grade) was audited as the adjacent large warehouse to the NW (the second Kenco building), centered ~38.3911, -85.6790. The roster's idx 10 geocode (38.356949, -85.66387) is wrong - it lands on an unrelated corporate visitor building several km south.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The truck yard along the SE dock face is open to River Ridge Parkway with only a grassed setback - no perimeter fence, barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth visible in any Street View. Typical open-layout River Ridge spec building.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks on the SE face only (single-load building, not cross-dock). Long ~456 m dock wall; estimated ~90 dock doors (50+ band). Count is approximate from overhead imagery - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Some trailers parked on the wide SE dock apron without tractors; estimated 10-25.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank on the SE face only - no separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep SE-face truck apron easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: River Ridge Commerce Center sits on the rural edge of Jeffersonville - the building's NW and NE sides back directly onto open farmland; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two Kenco buildings (Jeffersonville I and II) on the River Ridge campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; River Ridge has rail elsewhere but not to this building.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~39 acres for the building parcel including the SE truck yard.

citations.claim: Kenco opened a leased River Ridge (Jeffersonville) facility scalable to over 660,000 SF
River Ridge Development Authority lists Kenco operating two logistics buildings on the Jeffersonville side

verification.rationale: Kenco operates two River Ridge buildings (idx 1 + this adjacent second building); active operation through 2024-2026; no closure found. (Kenco Indianapolis closure is a different facility.)
